Warehousing

Lối đi kho

A designated passageway between rows of racking or shelving in a warehouse, enabling access for personnel and material-handling equipment, and defined in facility layout and safety documents.

Quick answer: A designated passageway between rows of racking or shelving in a warehouse, enabling access for personnel and material-handling equipment, and defined in facility layout and safety documents.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Lối đi kho?

In this glossary, Lối đi kho refers to: A designated passageway between rows of racking or shelving in a warehouse, enabling access for personnel and material-handling equipment, and defined in facility layout and safety documents.

How is Lối đi kho used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Lối đi kho phải luôn thông thoáng để xe nâng di chuyển an toàn và thoát hiểm khi cần."

Why does Lối đi kho matter in logistics?

Lối đi kho matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Lối đi kho?

Lối đi kho is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Lối đi kho belong to?

In this glossary, Lối đi kho is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.
